name: com.unity.2d.tilemap.extras
description:
2D Tilemap Extras is a package that contains extra scripts for use with 2D Tilemap features in Unity. These include custom Tiles and Brushes for the Tilemap feature.

The following are included in the package:
Brushes: GameObject Brush, Group Brush, Line Brush, Random Brush
Tiles: Animated Tile, Auto Tile, Rule Tile, Rule Override Tile
Other: Grid Information, Custom Rules for Rule Tile

samples.description: An example implementation of an Animated Tile and Animated Entity Id Tile.
An example implementation of a Rule Tile and Rule Entity Id Tile with rules matching four-way orthogonal neighbors.
An example implementation of a Rule Tile and Rule Entity Id Tile with rules matching eight-way orthogonal and diagonal neighbors.
An example implementation of Auto Tiles with 3x3 mask and a template.

- [GridUtility] Add GridUtility static class containing Grid space conversion methods using GridData. This can be used in Unity Jobs.
